reading_note: The teaching describes the four discrete degrees of divine love-and-wisdom presiding over creation (the Father as celestial-most good, the Third Ambassador as awakening truth, the Pillar of Glory as the ascending column of accumulated good, Jesus the Splendor as proceeding divine wisdom), each containing twelve hours = a complete set of truths at its degree. Mirror-wise it then traces the four corresponding nights — the four discrete degrees of self-love and falsity (the natural mind in darkness, Matter as the falsifying imagination, the worlds of flesh as carnal loves embodied, and the law/seventh dwelling as the dominion of falsified doctrine) — each likewise containing twelve hours of darkness. The arc moves from the celestial summit downward through the heavens, then traces the parallel descent through the hells, showing how every degree of light has its inverted shadow, and how the lower nights are bound and ordered by the higher days through the work of the First Man and Living Spirit.
